title: Code Isle
description: Write real JavaScript to help Pip the robot rebuild a foggy 3D island. 48 coding adventures teach commands, loops, variables, functions, if and else, while loops, arrays and objects, and everything you build stays in the world. Plus a Free Build meadow and a Code Book to look things up.
notes: 3D with the built-in Three.js 0.185.1 (pinned import map with integrity). Kids type (or tap chips to add) real JavaScript; it never runs as JavaScript: a small interpreter in the first <script> (window.CodeIsle: lexer, parser, tree-walking interpreter with step, call-depth, array-size and Pip-action limits, friendly errors with line numbers and 'did you mean' hints) runs it against Pip's world simulation, then the 3D view replays the recorded events with the running line highlighted. Supported: let/const/var, numbers, text, template text, arrays, objects, functions (declarations, expressions, arrows, defaults, return, this in methods), if/else, for, for...of, while, do...while, break/continue, ternary, && || ?? !, all math and comparison operators, ++/--/+= and friends, array and string methods, Math, console.log. Pip: forward(n), turnLeft/Right/Around, build(block, count), plant(kind), dig, paint(color), say, ahead, here, isBlocked, onFlag, height, heightAhead, facing (+ jumpTo(x, z) in Free Build). 10 chapters, 48 levels (window.CodeIsleLevels): First Steps (commands), Loop River (for loops), Number Hill (variables and math), Function Village (functions, inputs, return), Choice Marsh (if, else, else if, comparisons; tested in 3 worlds each), Pattern Garden (nested loops, %, ||), Crystal Caves (while loops, mazes), Rainbow Market (arrays, index, push), Castle Plans (objects) and The Glitch (everything). Goals: blueprint blocks, paint tiles, plants, gems, the flag, a gold star spot and things Pip must say. Stars: finished, used the lesson's idea, and code in par lines or fewer. Each level is a plot on one big island: unfinished plots are grey 'glitch' fog, finished plots keep what the player built. Saves in BRB.storage key 'code-isle-v1' (stars, best code, builds, drafts, Free Build, settings). Score: BRB.score.submit(total stars, 'stars') after each level; BRB.gameOver({ won: true, score }) at the ending. Test hooks: window.__brbTest (state, levels, start, setCode, run, finish, solve, unlockAll, map, title, closeDialog, closeModal, camera).
